newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 98 budget sees 2-pct growth, lower yields.
newsitem.headline: Russian 98 budget sees 2-pct growth, lower yields.

text.p: Russia's draft 1998 budget assumes gross domestic product will grow by two percent, ending eight years of decline, and inflation will more than halve to five percent, a senior government source said on Tuesday.
The draft budget, to be submitted by the finance ministry to the cabinet on Thursday, assumes yields on Treasury bills will fall to 12-14 percent from 18-19 percent currently, he said.
The draft assumes the central bank's refinancing rate will average 18-20 percent during 1998, the source said. It is currently 24 percent.
It also assumes industrial production will grow by three percent in 1998.
